{{Top|leg}}
An '''intrinsic force negator''' was an integral part of [[Umak Leth]]'s [[molecular furnace]]. It destroyed the chemical bonds of anything drawn into the furnace, which were then stored in force bubbles of [[thallium]], [[cadmium]], and [[Impervium/Legends|impervium]].
